grammar: Maximal physically contiguous standalone Move N: a op b = c or Step N: a op b = c lines, ASCII signed integer or fraction literals, operator + - * /. Require same label and numbering exactly 1..N; N <= min(5, input_count-1).
semantics: Replay literal equations in stated order from initial multiset using frozen apply_action with allow_fractions=False. Never correct, skip, reorder, search or execute candidate source. Every equation in whole block must be valid, including any after first target occurrence.
unsupported: Bullets, bold labels, bare numbered lines, decimals, Unicode operators, explanatory suffixes, blank-separated steps, inline/chained equations and other formats are unsupported or not detected; this does not imply reasoning lacks a solution.
offsets: Zero-based end-exclusive Python character offsets in retained reasoning; not tokens.
request_binding: SHA256 of exact retained request_start JSONL line bytes including newline; original HTTP request body not captured.
scope: Already-seen exploratory census, all 449 retained responses of direct/E2/E4/strong-solo; 292 length responses. Original metrics unchanged. No omitted response recovery.
baseline: Replay all 449 accepted-content fields independently and require agreement with retained verified reward.
evidence_policy: Exact extracted spans retained as audit evidence only, never used as future model input.
